text: A pair of polyhedra consists of a polyhedron and a subpolyhedron. When both are PL balls it is a ball pair. Ball-pair status is preserved by PL homeomorphisms of pairs; a literal cone pair is the local star construction and is not required of every geometrically embedded ball pair. Properness and unknottedness are separately defined qualifications.
